📖 How to use

  1. Press Battle to flip the top cards.
  2. Higher card wins both cards.
  3. Ties trigger WAR — 3 down, 1 up.
  4. Capture all 52 cards to win!

❓ Frequently asked questions

What are the rules?

Each player gets 26 cards. Higher card takes both; ties trigger a WAR — 3 face-down cards plus a deciding card.

Which card wins? What if someone runs out mid-war?

Aces are high. If a player can't complete a war, they lose immediately.

How are rounds tracked?

The round counter tracks every battle, and the log shows the last few results.

Is there an auto-play mode?

Yes — toggle Auto-play to watch battles resolve automatically, or play round by round.
